tacztweaks.config.title: TaCZ Tweaks
tacztweaks.config.category.general.name: General
tacztweaks.config.option.general.compati:
Force disables the buggy crawl feature in TaCZ for better compatibility with other mods.
This option should enable other mods using the crawl/swimming pose, such as crawl or revive mods, to work as expected.

Enables compatibility with the FirstAid mod.
This option makes the damage from bullets use the same logic as other projectiles, allowing them to damage the correct body parts.

Enables compatibility with the Legendary Survival Overhaul mod.
This option makes the damage from bullets use the same logic as other projectiles, allowing them to damage the correct body parts.

Enables compatibility with the Cuffed mod.
This option prevents you from shooting guns while handcuffed.

Enables compatibility with the Valkyrien Skies mod.
This option makes bullets properly interact with Valkyrien Skies ships.
Note: This option may alter the trajectory of bullets.

Enables compatibility with the Sable mod and any mods that utilize it, such as Create Aeronautics.
This option makes bullets properly interact with Sable sub-levels.
Note: This option may alter the trajectory of bullets.

Enables compatibility with the Immersive Vehicles mod.
This option disables the lag compensation against IV vehicle entities to fix incorrect hitboxes.
tacztweaks.config.option.general.fixes.c:
Fixes the TaCZ crawl cooldown feature.
This should fix the issue where you sometimes get stuck in the crawling state.
tacztweaks.config.option.general.fixes.t: Fixes the issue where the third-person hotbar gun rendering doesn't work when hands are empty.
tacztweaks.config.option.general.fixes.a:
Fixes the issue where the attachment compatibility checks used in some UIs are not accurate.
- Attachment Tooltip
- Gun Smith Table ('By Item In Hand' filter)
- JEI Attachment Query
tacztweaks.config.option.general.fixes.d:
Disables culling on bullets to prevent bullets being invisible on some cases.
This option might affect performance in some intense scenarios with a lot of bullets.
tacztweaks.config.option.general.miscell: Always Filter by Item in Hand
Always enables the 'By Item In Hand' filter in the Gun Smith Table.
Hides the incompatible attachment slots on the refit screen and only shows the available ones.
Replaces the RPM (rounds per minute) in the gun stats with RPS (rounds per second).

tacztweaks.config.option.gameplay.behavi:
Improves the TaCZ inaccuracy system to make it more realistic.
By default, the TaCZ inaccuracy system only accounts for one state at a time.
For example, moving while aiming results in the exact same inaccuracy as just aiming.
This option enables the system to account for multiple states simultaneously, based on the percentage difference from the standing state.

Reworks the gun-tilting mechanic to be an actual gameplay feature.
- Sneaking no longer tilts the gun. Instead, you can press the 'Tilt Gun' key to tilt the gun at any time.
- Tilting reduces inaccuracy.

Makes reloading discard the remaining rounds in the magazine.
For example, reloading a gun with 16/32 ammo remaining will consume 32 ammo instead of 16.
List of gun IDs to exclude from the effect of the 'Reload Discards Magazine' option.
Makes the Projectile Protection enchantment reduce bullet damage.
Makes endermen teleport away from bullets before getting hit.
Provides a bottomless magazine while the player has infinite ammo (e.g. from the creative ammo box).
tacztweaks.config.group.gameplay.crawl.d: Configurations related to the crawling feature in TaCZ.
Dynamically adjusts the pitch limit based on the hitbox of the block while crawling.

tacztweaks.config.option.balancing.modif:
Modifies the value by executing this Lua function.

Available variables:
x: A value after addend and multiplier are applied
r: Base value before addend and multiplier are applied
y: The output value

Example: `if (x > 20) then y = r + 5 else y = x * 3 end`
